amendments.reason: Declared before any C3 composition is assembled or scored. The UPGRADE delta compared the two provider records by whitespace-collapsed string, but the two records come from two independent S2 runs: across 35 same-element declaration pairs in the returned recons, differences included macros and labels (formatting), another line of the same declaration (#define vs #ifndef of an include guard), another representation of the same definition (a MAVLink C++ struct vs its XML), a C implementation vs a Python signature (numpy), and C parameter names. Such a transcription difference on an implicated element would give ECM a field_break right_reason that A2 cannot catch, because both excerpts are real. Fix, in two layers: (1) assemble.py compares a canonical form (label, visibility/attribute macros and punctuation spacing dropped; types, parameters, defaults and values kept); (2) A2 question 4 asks both adjudicators whether each changed field differs in substance or only in transcription, and fold() demotes the path unless the final verdict is substantive (missing answer = unverifiable; a pending split does not count).
amendments.scope: assembly of every UPGRADE composition (none assembled yet for the corpora)

amendments.reason: fold() added a missed condition only when both adjudicators named its class, and silently dropped one named by a single adjudicator: no split, no third adjudicator.
